blink.name: Blink Dagger
blink.desc:
Blink: Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away. 

Blink Dagger cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

overwhelming_blink.name: Overwhelming Blink
overwhelming_blink.desc:
Overwhelming Blink: Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, all enemies in a 800 AoE take damage equal to 100 + 50% of your strength and an additional 100% over time, and have 50% movement speed slow and 50 attack speed slow for 6 seconds. 

Overwhelming Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

swift_blink.name: Swift Blink
swift_blink.desc:
Swift Blink: Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, you gain 40% phased movement speed and +35 Agility for 6 seconds. 

Swift Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

arcane_blink.name: Arcane Blink
arcane_blink.desc:
Arcane Blink: Teleport to a target point up to 1400 units away. 

After teleportation, you restore 250 health and 100 mana.

Arcane Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

javelin.name: Javelin
javelin.desc: Pierce: Grants each attack a 25% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 60 bonus magical damage.

quelling_blade.name: Quelling Blade
quelling_blade.desc:
Chop Tree: Destroy a target tree.
Quell: Increases attack damage against non-hero units by 8 for melee heroes, and 4 for ranged.

infused_raindrop.name: Infused Raindrops
infused_raindrop.desc:
Magical Damage Block: Consumes a charge to block 120 magic damage from damage instances over 75 damage. 

Comes with 6 charges. When the charges are gone, the item disappears.

moon_shard.name: Moon Shard
moon_shard.desc:
Consume: Consume the Moon Shard to permanently gain 60 attack speed and 200 bonus night vision. Max 1 use.
Shade Sight: Grants bonus night vision.

branches.name: Iron Branch
branches.desc: Plant Tree: Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts for 20 seconds.

lifesteal.name: Morbid Mask
lifesteal.desc: Lifesteal: Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

voodoo_mask.name: Voodoo Mask
voodoo_mask.desc: Spell Lifesteal: Heals the wearer for a percentage of spell damage dealt to enemies.

gem.name: Gem of True Sight
gem.desc:
Reveal: Gives True Sight over a 300 radius revealing wards and units even in Fog of War.
True Sight: Grants the ability to see invisible units and wards to any allied vision within 900 range of its carrier.
Everlasting: Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed.

magic_stick.name: Magic Stick
magic_stick.desc:
Energy Charge: Instantly restores 15 health and mana per charge stored.

 Max 10 charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within 1200 range uses an ability.

magic_wand.name: Magic Wand
magic_wand.desc:
Energy Charge: Instantly restores 15 health and mana per charge stored. 

Max 20 charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within 1200 range uses an ability.

ghost.name: Ghost Scepter
ghost.desc: Ghost Form: You enter ghost form for 4 seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and -30% more vulnerable to magic damage.

clarity.name: Clarity
clarity.desc:
Replenish: Grants 6 mana regeneration to the target for 25 seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

blood_grenade.name: Blood Grenade
blood_grenade.desc: Throw Grenade: Throw a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take 50 damage on impact, and be slowed by -15% and take 15 damage every 1s for 5 seconds. Radius 300.

flask.name: Healing Salve
flask.desc:
Salve: Grants 30 health regeneration to the target for 13 seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

Heals for half the amount per second when cast on an ally.

dust.name: Dust of Appearance
dust.desc:
Reveal: For 12 seconds, creates an area that reveals and slows invisible heroes by -20% in a 1050 radius where the caster was standing. Invisible units revealed by dust take 25 damage.

 The debuff effect on enemies lingers for 8s after leaving the area of effect.

bottle.name: Bottle
bottle.desc:
Regenerate: Consumes a charge to restore 110 health and 60 mana over 2.7 seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

The Bottle automatically refills at the fountain.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.
Store Rune: Runes can be stored in the Bottle for later use by right-clicking them. Unused runes will automatically activate after 90 seconds.

Using a stored rune fully refills the Bottle.

ward_sentry.name: Sentry Ward
ward_sentry.desc:
Plant: Plants a Sentry Ward, an invisible watcher that grants True Sight, the ability to see invisible enemy units and wards, to any existing allied vision within a 1050 radius.
Lasts 7 minutes.

Does not grant ground vision.
Hold Control to give one Sentry Ward to an allied hero.

tango.name: Tango
tango.desc:
Devour: Consumes a target tree to gain 7 health regeneration for 16 seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.

Comes with 3 charges. Can be used on an allied hero to give them one Tango.

Tree Range: 165

tpscroll.name: Town Portal Scroll
tpscroll.desc:
Teleport: After channeling for 3 seconds, teleports you to a target friendly building. 

Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.

travel_boots.name: Boots of Travel
travel_boots.desc: Town Portal Scroll: Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units, reduces cooldown and does not consume a charge on usage.

travel_boots_2.name: Boots of Travel 2
travel_boots_2.desc: Town Portal Scroll: Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units and heroes, reduces cooldown, channel time and does not consume a charge on usage.

phase_boots.name: Phase Boots
phase_boots.desc: Phase: Gives 20% increased movement speed on melee heroes, and 10% on ranged heroes, and lets you move through units and turn more quickly for 3 seconds.

power_treads.name: Power Treads
power_treads.desc: Switch Attribute: Switches between +10 Strength, +10 Agility, or +10 Intelligence.

phylactery.name: Phylactery
phylactery.desc: Empower Spell: The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate 150 bonus damage to the target and slows them by 30% for 3s.

angels_demise.name: Khanda
angels_demise.desc: Empower Spell: The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate 250 additional damage, disables their passives, and slows their movement speed by 30% for 4s.

hand_of_midas.name: Hand of Midas
hand_of_midas.desc:
Transmute: Kills a non-hero target for 160 gold. Killing a neutral creep additionally grants a madstone bundle. 

 Cannot be used on Ancient creeps.

witch_blade.name: Witch Blade
witch_blade.desc: Witch Blade: Causes your next attack to apply a poison for 4 seconds, slowing by 25% and dealing 0.75x your intelligence as damage every second. This attack has True Strike.

poor_mans_shield.name: Poor Man's Shield
poor_mans_shield.desc:
Damage Block: Gives a 100% chance to block 30 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 20 damage on ranged.

Has a 50% chance to block damage from creeps.

mekansm.name: Mekansm
mekansm.desc:
Restore: Restores 250 health to allied units in a 1200 radius.
Mekansm Aura: Grants 2.5 health regeneration to allied units in a 1200 radius.

vladmir.name: Vladmir's Offering
vladmir.desc:
Vladmir's Aura: Grants 20% lifesteal, 18% bonus damage, 1 mana regeneration, and 2 armor to nearby allies.

Radius: 1200

buckler.name: Buckler
buckler.desc:
Buckler Aura: Grants 2 armor to allied player units.

Radius: 1200

ring_of_basilius.name: Ring of Basilius
ring_of_basilius.desc:
Basilius Aura: Grants 1 mana regeneration to allies. 

Radius: 1200

holy_locket.name: Holy Locket
holy_locket.desc:
Energy Charge: Target an allied unit to increase their incoming Heal Amplification by 10% for 4s and instantly restore 17 health and 15 mana per charge stored. 

Automatically gains a charge every 10 seconds and whenever a visible enemy within 1200 range uses an ability.
Holy Blessing: Amplifies heals you provide by 15%.

pipe.name: Pipe of Insight
pipe.desc:
Barrier: Gives a magic damage barrier that absorbs 425 damage to all nearby allies. Lasts 8 seconds.

Radius: 1200
Insight Aura: Gives allied units 8% magic resistance.

Radius: 1200

urn_of_shadows.name: Urn of Shadows
urn_of_shadows.desc:
Soul Release: Provides 30 health regeneration when cast on allies, and deals 25 damage per second when cast on enemies.

Lasts 8 seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within 1500 units.

headdress.name: Headdress
headdress.desc:
Regeneration Aura: Grants 2 health regeneration to allies.

Radius: 1200

sheepstick.name: Scythe of Vyse
sheepstick.desc:
Hex: Turns a target unit into a harmless critter for 2.8 seconds. The target has a base movement speed of 140 and will be silenced, muted, and disarmed.
Instantly destroys illusions.

orchid.name: Orchid Malevolence
orchid.desc: Soul Burn: Silences the target unit for 5 seconds. At the end of the silence, 30% of the damage received while silenced is inflicted as bonus magical damage.

bloodthorn.name: Bloodthorn
bloodthorn.desc:
Soul Rend: Silences a target for 5 seconds. At the end of the silence, an additional 60% of all damage taken during the silence will be dealt to the target as magical damage.

All attacks on the silenced target will deal additional damage equal to 50 if the attacker is a hero, and 25, if the attacker is a creep. Provides True Strike for your attacks and attacks from your controlled units against the silenced target.
Pierce: Grants each attack a 40% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 60 bonus magical damage.

echo_sabre.name: Echo Sabre
echo_sabre.desc: Echo Strike: Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a 100% movement slow for 0.8 seconds on the first strike.

cyclone.name: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
cyclone.desc:
Cyclone: Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for 2.5 seconds. Cyclone can only be cast on enemy units or yourself.

Enemy units take 50 magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

wind_waker.name: Wind Waker
wind_waker.desc:
Cyclone: Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for 2.5 seconds. Cyclone can be cast on yourself, enemy units or allied units. When cast on yourself, you can move the tornado at a speed of 300.

Enemy units take 50 magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

force_staff.name: Force Staff
force_staff.desc: Force: Pushes any target unit 600 units in the direction it is facing.

hurricane_pike.name: Hurricane Pike
hurricane_pike.desc:
Hurricane Thrust: Pushes you and target enemy 425 units away from each other, and for 6 seconds, allows you to make 5 attacks against the target without range restrictions and with +100 attack speed.

Can be cast on self or allies to push the target 600 units in the direction it is facing.
Enemy Range: 425

dagon.name: Dagon
dagon.desc:
Energy Burst: Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: 400
 Mana Cost: 120

dagon_2.name: Dagon
dagon_2.desc:
Energy Burst: Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: 400
 Mana Cost: 120

dagon_3.name: Dagon
dagon_3.desc:
Energy Burst: Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: 400
 Mana Cost: 120

dagon_4.name: Dagon
dagon_4.desc:
Energy Burst: Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: 400
 Mana Cost: 120

dagon_5.name: Dagon
dagon_5.desc:
Energy Burst: Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. 

Damage: 400
 Mana Cost: 120

ultimate_scepter.name: Aghanim's Scepter
ultimate_scepter.desc: Ability Upgrade: Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.

ultimate_scepter_2.name: Aghanim's Blessing
ultimate_scepter_2.desc: Ability Upgrade: Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.

aghanims_shard.name: Aghanim's Shard
aghanims_shard.desc: Ability Upgrade: Upgrades an existing ability or adds a new ability to your hero.

refresher.name: Refresher Orb
refresher.desc: Reset Cooldowns: Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Shard. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.

assault.name: Assault Cuirass
assault.desc:
Assault Aura: Grants 30 attack speed and 5 armor to nearby allied units and structures, and decreases nearby enemy unit and structure armor by -5.

Radius: 1200

heart.name: Heart of Tarrasque
heart.desc: Behemoth's Blood: Your health regeneration is increased by 1.5% of your missing health.

black_king_bar.name: Black King Bar
black_king_bar.desc:
Avatar: Applies a basic dispel. Grants 60% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect. 

Duration: 9s 
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

shivas_guard.name: Shiva's Guard
shivas_guard.desc:
Arctic Blast: Emits a freezing wave that deals 260 magical damage to enemies and slows their movement by -40% for 4 seconds.

Radius: 825
Freezing Aura: Reduces the attack speed of all enemies by -45. 

Radius: 1200

bloodstone.name: Bloodstone
bloodstone.desc:
Bloodpact: Increases Bloodstone's Spell Lifesteal to 60%. Lasts 5 seconds.
Spell Weakness Aura: Enemy units take 12% increased damage from spells. 

Radius: 1200

sphere.name: Linken's Sphere
sphere.desc:
Spellblock: Blocks most targeted spells once every 14 seconds.
Transfer Spellblock: Temporarily removes Spellblock from the item's owner and transfers it to an allied unit for 14 seconds.

lotus_orb.name: Lotus Orb
lotus_orb.desc:
Echo Shell: Applies a shield to the target unit for 5 seconds which re-casts most targeted spells back to their caster.

The shielded unit will still take damage from the spell.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

meteor_hammer.name: Meteor Hammer
meteor_hammer.desc:
Meteor Hammer: CHANNELED - After a successful channel, summons a meteor that strikes a 400 AoE, stunning enemies for 0.75 seconds and dealing impact damage. Continues to deal damage over time to enemies units and buildings for 6 seconds. Non-building units are also slowed for 20% for the duration of the burn. 

Building Impact Damage: 90 
Building Over Time Damage: 50 

Non-Building Impact Damage: 130 
Non-Building Over Time Damage: 50 

Channel Duration: 2 seconds.
Landing Time: 0.5 seconds.

nullifier.name: Nullifier
nullifier.desc:
Nullify: Dispels the target and applies a debuff for 4 seconds. Continuously dispels and slows the target.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

aeon_disk.name: Aeon Disk
aeon_disk.desc: Combo Breaker: When you take damage and your health falls below 70%, a strong dispel is applied and you gain a 2.5 second buff that provides +75% Status Resistance and causes all damage you deal and are dealt to be reduced to zero. Only triggers on player based damage. Cooldown increases every time it triggers.Dispel Type: Strong Dispel

spirit_vessel.name: Spirit Vessel
spirit_vessel.desc:
Soul Release: When used against enemies, it reduces health by 4% of current health per second, and reduces Health Restoration by 70%. Deals 25 damage per second. 

When used on allies, it provides 40 health regeneration per second. 

Lasts 8 seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within 1500 units or the user dies.

essence_distiller.name: Essence Distiller
essence_distiller.desc:
Soul Release: Provides 40 health regeneration when cast on allies.

Can be ground targeted to lie dormant for up to 15s and attach to the first enemy that comes within 400 radius. When on enemies, deals 25 damage per second and provides True Sight over them and shares their vision with the wearer's team.

Lasts 8 seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within 1500 units.

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.desc: Damage Block: Grants a 60% chance to block 50 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 25 damage on ranged.

crimson_guard.name: Crimson Guard
crimson_guard.desc:
Guard: For 7 seconds, grant nearby allied heroes and buildings a 100% chance to block damage equal to 70 plus 2% of the caster's max health value from each incoming attack.

Radius: 1200
Damage Block: Grants a 60% chance to block 75 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 50 damage on ranged.

blade_mail.name: Blade Mail
blade_mail.desc:
Damage Return: For 5.5 seconds, return all incoming damage, increasing the percentage by 85%.
Damage Return: Everytime you are attacked, you return 10 damage plus 15% of the attack damage dealt to you.

consecrated_wraps.name: Consecrated Wraps
consecrated_wraps.desc:
Hallowed: Gain a stack every 3s, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. Upon gaining a stack, your movement speed is increased by 20% for 7s.

Whenever you take damage from a player-controlled unit or Roshan, consume all stacks to gain an all damage barrier for 7s that absorbs 120 damage per stack (360 max).

crellas_crozier.name: Crella's Crozier
crellas_crozier.desc:
Rite of Rumusque: You enter ghost form for 4 seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and -30% more vulnerable to magic damage.

Steal 5% movement speed from enemy heroes in 900 range every second. Movement speed steal lasts 1.5s.

Putrefaction Aura's effect is increased to 75%. All of the lost Health Restoration is redirected to you every second.
Putrefaction Aura: Reduces nearby enemy heroes' Health Restoration by 30%.

Radius: 900

rapier.name: Divine Rapier
rapier.desc:
Transmute: Toggle to gain either 25% bonus spell amplification or 250 bonus attack damage.
Everlasting: Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed. 

Becomes unusable if picked up by an ally of its owner until it is returned to its owner. It is immediately usable by anybody if an enemy of the owner picks it up and is killed. A dropped Rapier cannot be picked up by a courier.

monkey_king_bar.name: Monkey King Bar
monkey_king_bar.desc: Pierce: Grants each attack a 80% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 70 bonus magical damage.

radiance.name: Radiance
radiance.desc:
Burn: When active, scorches enemies for 60 magical damage per second. Illusions deal 35 magical damage per second.

Radius: 650

greater_crit.name: Daedalus
greater_crit.desc: Critical Strike: Grants each attack a 30% chance to deal 225% damage.

basher.name: Skull Basher
basher.desc: Bash: Grants melee heroes a 25% chance on hit to stun the target for 1.2 seconds and deal 100 bonus physical damage. Bash chance for ranged heroes is 10%.

bfury.name: Battle Fury
bfury.desc:
Chop Tree: Destroy a target tree.
Quell: Increases attack damage against non-hero units by 10 for melee heroes, and 5 for ranged.
Cleave: Deals 60% of attack damage as physical damage in a cone up to 650 around the target. Deals 40% against creeps. (Melee Only)

manta.name: Manta Style
manta.desc:
Mirror Image: Creates 2 images of your hero that last 18 seconds. 

Melee images deal 33% damage, while Ranged images deal 28%. Illusions take 300% damage. 

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

lesser_crit.name: Crystalys
lesser_crit.desc: Critical Strike: Grants each attack a 30% chance to deal 160% damage.

armlet.name: Armlet of Mordiggian
armlet.desc:
Unholy Strength: When active, Unholy Strength grants +35 damage, +25 strength and +4 armor, but drains 45 health per second.

 You cannot die from the health drain when Unholy Strength is activated, nor from the strength loss when Unholy Strength is deactivated.

invis_sword.name: Shadow Blade
invis_sword.desc:
Shadow Walk: Makes you invisible for 17 seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell. While Shadow Walk is active, you move 20% faster and can move through units. 

If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain 175 bonus physical damage on that attack.

silver_edge.name: Silver Edge
silver_edge.desc:
Shadow Walk: Makes you invisible for 17 seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell. While invisible, you move 25% faster and can move through units. 

Attacking to end the invisibility will deal 300 bonus physical damage, disable their passive abilities for 5 seconds, and cap their movement speed to 200.

satanic.name: Satanic
satanic.desc:
Unholy Rage: Increases Lifesteal percentage to 175% for 6 seconds. 

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
Lifesteal: Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

mjollnir.name: Mjollnir
mjollnir.desc:
Static Charge: Places a charged shield on a target unit for 15 seconds which has a 20% chance to release a 225 magical damage shocking bolt at a nearby attacker and 4 additional enemies.
Chain Lightning: Grants a 25% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between 12 targets within a 650 radius, dealing 180 magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.

skadi.name: Eye of Skadi
skadi.desc: Cold Attack: Attacks lower enemy movement by -25% if they are melee and -50% if they are ranged. Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by -20% and Health Restoration by 50%. Lasts for 3 seconds.

helm_of_the_dominator.name: Helm of the Dominator
helm_of_the_dominator.desc:
Dominate: Takes control of one neutral, non-ancient target unit and sets its movement speed to 370 and max health to a minimum of 1000. Also provides the unit with +25 base attack damage, +12 health regen, +4 mana regen and +4 armor. 

Dominated units with a max health of greater than 1000 retain their original max health. Grants the caster 50% of the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to 100 gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.

The Helm cannot be used for 3 seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

helm_of_the_overlord.name: Helm of the Overlord
helm_of_the_overlord.desc:
Dominate: Takes control of one neutral target unit and sets its movement speed to 380 and max health to a minimum of 1800. Also provides the unit with +70 base attack damage, +12 health regen, +4 mana regen, +7 armor, and levels up some abilities of the target by 1 level. 

Dominated units with a max health of greater than 1800 retain their original max health. Grants the caster the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to 250 gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.

The Helm cannot be used for 3 seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

maelstrom.name: Maelstrom
maelstrom.desc: Chain Lightning: Grants a 25% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between 4 targets within a 650 radius, dealing 110 magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.

gungir.name: Gleipnir
gungir.desc: Eternal Chains: Roots all enemies in a 350 radius for 2 seconds.

desolator.name: Desolator
desolator.desc:
Corruption: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -6 for 7 seconds.
Soul Stealer: Desolator gains +2 damage every time an enemy hero dies while affected by Corruption, to a maximum of 30.

mask_of_madness.name: Mask of Madness
mask_of_madness.desc:
Berserk: Gives 100 attack speed, 8% / 12% movement speed (ranged/melee), and 30% slow resistance, but reduces your armor by 7 and silences you. Lasts 6 seconds.
Lifesteal: Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

diffusal_blade.name: Diffusal Blade
diffusal_blade.desc:
Inhibit: Targets an enemy, slowing it for 4 seconds.
Manabreak: Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana. 

Illusions do not burn mana.

disperser.name: Disperser
disperser.desc:
Suppress: Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for 5 seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and 40% slow resistance for 5 seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.

Both movement speed reduction and increase start at 100% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
Manabreak: Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana. 

Illusions do not burn mana.

ethereal_blade.name: Ethereal Blade
ethereal_blade.desc:
Ether Blast: Converts the target unit to ethereal form, rendering them immune to physical damage, but unable to attack and -30% more vulnerable to magic damage.

 Enemy targets are also slowed by -80%, and take 1x the sum of all your attributes + 50 as magical damage.
Duration: 4 seconds

soul_ring.name: Soul Ring
soul_ring.desc:
Sacrifice: Consume %abilityhealthcost% health to temporarily gain 170 mana. Lasts 10 seconds.

If the mana gained cannot fit in your mana pool, it creates a buffer of mana that will be used before your mana pool.

arcane_boots.name: Arcane Boots
arcane_boots.desc:
Replenish: Restores 150 mana to all nearby allies.

Radius: 1200
Basilius Aura: Grants 1 mana regeneration to allies. 

Radius: 1200

orb_of_venom.name: Orb of Venom
orb_of_venom.desc: Poison Attack: Poisons the target, dealing 10 magical damage per second. Lasts for 3 seconds.

blight_stone.name: Orb of Blight
blight_stone.desc: Lesser Corruption: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -2 for 3 seconds.

orb_of_corrosion.name: Orb of Corrosion
orb_of_corrosion.desc: Corrosion: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -2, slows their movement by -16% (-8% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by 16%. Lasts for 3 seconds.

orb_of_frost.name: Orb of Frost
orb_of_frost.desc: Frost: Your attacks slow the target's movement by -13% (-6% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by 13%. Lasts for 3 seconds.

mage_slayer.name: Mage Slayer
mage_slayer.desc: Mage Slayer: Places a debuff when you attack enemies, dealing 40 physical damage per second and causing them to do 40% less spell damage for 3 seconds.

ancient_janggo.name: Drum of Endurance
ancient_janggo.desc:
Endurance: Gives +35 attack speed and +13% movement speed to nearby allies for 6 seconds.

Radius: 1200
Swiftness Aura: Grants 15 movement speed and 2.5 health regeneration to allies. 

Radius: 1200

boots_of_bearing.name: Boots of Bearing
boots_of_bearing.desc:
Endurance: Gives +50 attack speed and +15% movement speed to nearby allies for 6 seconds. For the first 1.5 seconds allies are immune to slows.

 Radius: 1200
Swiftness Aura: Grants 20 movement speed and 2.5 health regeneration to allies. 

Radius: 1200

medallion_of_courage.name: Medallion of Courage
medallion_of_courage.desc: Valor: Increases armor by 7 or decreases armor by -4 for 8s depending on if cast on an ally or enemy. Cannot be cast on self.

solar_crest.name: Solar Crest
solar_crest.desc:
Shine: When cast on an ally, grants them 5 armor, 60 attack speed, 15% movement speed and a 350 physical damage barrier. 

Does not grant bonus armor, movement or attack speed if used on self. 

Duration: 7

pavise.name: Pavise
pavise.desc: Protect: When cast on an ally, grants them a physical damage barrier that absorbs 250 damage. Duration: 7s.

smoke_of_deceit.name: Smoke of Deceit
smoke_of_deceit.desc:
Disguise: Turns the caster and all allied player-controlled units in a 1200 radius invisible, and grants 15% bonus movement speed for 45 seconds. 

 While the caster is still disguised, any allies that come within 300 range of them will also get the buff applied to them. Each smoke can only be applied once to allies. 

Attacking or moving within 1025 range of an enemy hero or tower, will break the invisibility. 

Disguise grants invisibility that is immune to True Sight. 

Smoke of Deceit is usable from the backpack and has no cooldown when swapped into the main inventory.

veil_of_discord.name: Veil of Discord
veil_of_discord.desc:
Spell Weakness: Cast a 900 radius blast that causes enemy heroes to take 10% increased damage from spells.

Can be cast while channeling.

Duration: 16 seconds.

revenants_brooch.name: Revenant's Brooch
revenants_brooch.desc: Phantom Critical: Grants each attack a 30% chance to deal an additional 80% of the attack's damage as bonus magic damage.

devastator.name: Parasma
devastator.desc:
Witch Blade: Causes your next attack to have true strike, apply a poison for 4 seconds, slowing by 25% and dealing 0.75x your intelligence as damage every second.
Magic Corruption: Your attacks reduce the enemy's Magic resistance by 20% for 4 seconds.

guardian_greaves.name: Guardian Greaves
guardian_greaves.desc:
Mend: Restores 325 health and 200 mana to nearby allies, and removes most negative effects from the caster.

Radius: 1200
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
Guardian Aura: Grants 2.5 health regeneration and 1.5 mana regeneration to allied units. If the wearer's health falls below 25%, their health regeneration is increased to 14.5. 

Radius: 1200

rod_of_atos.name: Rod of Atos
rod_of_atos.desc: Cripple: Roots the target for 2 seconds.

abyssal_blade.name: Abyssal Blade
abyssal_blade.desc:
Overwhelm: Stuns a target enemy unit for 1.6 seconds. 

Pierces Debuff Immunity.
Bash: Grants melee heroes a 25% chance on hit to stun the target for 1.2 seconds and deal 120 bonus physical damage. Bash chance for ranged heroes is 10%.

heavens_halberd.name: Heaven's Halberd
heavens_halberd.desc: Disarm: Prevents a target from attacking for 3.5 seconds.

tranquil_boots.name: Tranquil Boots
tranquil_boots.desc: Break: Whenever you attack a hero or are attacked by any unit, the bonus 14 HP regen is lost and the movement speed bonus is reduced to 40 for 13 seconds.

shadow_amulet.name: Shadow Amulet
shadow_amulet.desc: Fade: Grants invisibility to you or a target allied hero for 3.5s. Movement speed during the invisibility is reduced by 35%.

glimmer_cape.name: Glimmer Cape
glimmer_cape.desc:
Glimmer: After a 0.5 second delay, grants invisibility, 20 movement speed and a magic damage barrier that absorbs up to 375 damage to you or a target allied unit for 5 seconds.

Can be cast while channeling.

desolator_2.name: Stygian Desolator
desolator_2.desc: Greater Corruption: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -13 for 7 seconds.

spider_legs.name: Spider Legs
spider_legs.desc: Skitter: Grants you 20% bonus movement speed, 50% improved turn rate, and free pathing for 14 seconds. Walking over trees causes them to be destroyed.

essence_ring.name: Essence Ring
essence_ring.desc: Life Essence: Increases your current and max health by 240 for 10 seconds.

demonicon.name: Book of the Dead
demonicon.desc: Greater Demonic Summoning: Summon 2 demonic warriors and 2 demonic archers that last 65 seconds. The Warrior burns mana every hit, reveals invisible units, and deals magical damage to whoever kills it. The Archer has a basic dispel ability with a slow and a passive movement speed aura.

fallen_sky.name: Fallen Sky
fallen_sky.desc:
Fallen Sky: Transform into a meteor that strikes down at the target area after 1 seconds in a 315 AoE, stunning enemies for 1.6 seconds and dealing impact damage. Continues to deal damage every 1 seconds to enemy units and buildings for 6 seconds.

Building Impact Damage: 75 
Building Over Time Damage: 60 

Non-Building Impact Damage: 150 
Non-Building Over Time Damage: 60

Fallen Sky cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

minotaur_horn.name: Minotaur Horn
minotaur_horn.desc:
Lesser Avatar: Applies a basic dispel. Grants 50% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage for 2s. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

chipped_vest.name: Chipped Vest
chipped_vest.desc: Chipper: Every time you are attacked, you return 30 damage to heroes and 15 damage to creeps.

cloak_of_flames.name: Cloak of Flames
cloak_of_flames.desc: Immolate: Burns enemy units in a 375 unit radius for 40 damage per second. Illusions deal 25 damage per second.

possessed_mask.name: Possessed Mask
possessed_mask.desc: Lifesteal: Heals the attacker for 5 HP on each attack.

psychic_headband.name: Psychic Headband
psychic_headband.desc: Psychic Push: Pushes the target enemy unit away from you 400 distance.

stormcrafter.name: Stormcrafter
stormcrafter.desc: Bottled Lightning: Zaps 2 enemy targets within 700 range, dealing 70 damage and a 40% slow for 0.4 seconds.

heavy_blade.name: Witchbane
heavy_blade.desc:
Cleanse: Dispel all enemies and allies in a 300 unit radius.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
Subjugate: Your attacks deal bonus magical damage equal to 4% of your target's Max Mana.

pogo_stick.name: Tumbler's Toy
pogo_stick.desc: Vault: Propels your hero forward 300 units. Tumbler's Toy gets disabled for 3 seconds if its owner receives damage from a player source.

seeds_of_serenity.name: Seeds of Serenity
seeds_of_serenity.desc: Verdurous Dale: Target the ground with a 400 radius. Provides health regeneration to all allied units while they are in the area of effect equal to 8 + 25% of the caster's health regeneration at the time of casting. Lasts 8 seconds.

occult_bracelet.name: Occult Bracelet
occult_bracelet.desc: Rites of Eloshar: Each time the wearer is attacked, they gain a stack of 0.4 mana regen, up to 5 stacks. Stacks last for 5 seconds.

harpoon.name: Harpoon
harpoon.desc:
Draw Forth: When targeting an enemy, fire a harpoon at them, that pulls you and the target closer together, up to 35% of the distance between you and your target. If the caster is melee, the hero and target are always pulled to within melee distance of each other. Targeting a tree always pulls you all the way to that tree.
Echo Strike: Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a 100% movement slow for 1 seconds on the first strike. Echo Strike cooldown: 5s

defiant_shell.name: Defiant Shell
defiant_shell.desc: Reciprocity: When attacked, the hero counter-attacks a target within their attack range for 80% of their regular attack damage.

dagger_of_ristul.name: Dagger of Ristul
dagger_of_ristul.desc: Imbrue: Consume health to temporarily gain 25 damage for 8 seconds.

duelist_gloves.name: Duelist Gloves
duelist_gloves.desc: Boldness: Grants 20 attack speed as long as there are enemy heroes within 1200 units.

dandelion_amulet.name: Dandelion Amulet
dandelion_amulet.desc: Magical Damage Block: Every 12s, blocks up to 300 magic damage from damage instances over 75 damage.

rattlecage.name: Rattlecage
rattlecage.desc: Reverberate: After taking 220 damage from any source, the wearer fires a projectile at up to 2 random enemies in a 600 radius, prioritizing heroes, that deal 110 physical damage and slow the targets movement and attack speed by 100% for 0.2s.

unrelenting_eye.name: Unrelenting Eye
unrelenting_eye.desc: Relentless: Increases slow resistance by 50%. This bonus is reduced by 10% for every enemy hero within the wearer's attack radius.

mana_draught.name: Mana Draught
mana_draught.desc:
Bottoms Up: Restores 70 + 3% of the caster's maximum mana over 6 seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.
Fill Up: Cooldown Speed of Mana Draught is increased by 30% while in water.

crippling_crossbow.name: Crippling Crossbow
crippling_crossbow.desc: Hobble: Hits an enemy for 25 damage, then slows them by 50% and reduces Health Restoration by 40% for 4 seconds. The slow gradually fades over the duration of the spell.

gunpowder_gauntlets.name: Gunpowder Gauntlet
gunpowder_gauntlets.desc: Beat the Crowd: Your next attack deals an additional 120 magic damage and splashes to units within 250 units for 50% of the original attack's damage plus the additional magic damage.

searing_signet.name: Searing Signet
searing_signet.desc: Burn Through: Instances of magic damage from spells over 60 ignites enemies, causing them to take 80 magic damage over 6 seconds. Burn damage against non-hero targets is decreased by 50%.

serrated_shiv.name: Serrated Shiv
serrated_shiv.desc: Gut 'Em: Attacks have a 20% chance to have True Strike and deal 8% of the target's current health as bonus physical damage. Deals a flat bonus of 200 against Roshan.

polliwog_charm.name: Pollywog Charm
polliwog_charm.desc: Ribbit: Increases the health regeneration of a target ally by 8 for 14 seconds. While standing in water, the blessed unit also moves 10% faster.

kobold_cup.name: Kobold Cup
kobold_cup.desc: One for the Road: Increases movement speed of all allied units by 10% in a 1000 unit radius around the caster for 6 seconds.

dormant_curio.name: Dormant Curio
dormant_curio.desc: Hidden Potential: Neutral Artifacts you craft while holding a Dormant Curio have their potency increased by 30%.

jidi_pollen_bag.name: Jidi Pollen Bag
jidi_pollen_bag.desc: Pollinate: Spreads pollen on all enemy units in a 700 unit radius for 9 seconds, decreasing their health restoration by 50% and dealing damage equal to 9% of their maximum health per second.

dezun_bloodrite.name: Dezun Bloodrite
dezun_bloodrite.desc: Blood Invocation: Spells have a 16% larger Area of Effect, but now additionally cost health equal to 35% of their mana cost.

giant_maul.name: Giant's Maul
giant_maul.desc: Crushing Blow: Empowers the next attack to be a critical hit dealing 150% damage. Hitting an enemy with an empowered attack temporarily decreases their movement speed by 10%, attack speed by 15%, and cast speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

divine_regalia.name: Divine Regalia
divine_regalia.desc: Exalted: Increases outgoing damage by 20%. Dying permanently disables this Neutral Item and the current Enchantment is lost.

specialists_array.name: Specialist's Array
specialists_array.desc: Splitshot: Ranged attacks have a 30% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to 2 nearby enemies with 150 extra range and within a 120 degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal 20 + 75% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects. The primary attack deals 20 + 100% damage of a normal attack.

hydras_breath.name: Hydra's Breath
hydras_breath.desc:
Miasma: Attacks poison enemies, dealing 2.5% of the target's Max HP as Magical Damage per second for 3 seconds.
Polycephaly: Ranged attacks have a 30% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to 3 nearby enemies with 150 extra range and within a 120 degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal 20 + 75% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects except for Miasma. The primary attack deals 20 + 100% damage of a normal attack.

weighted_dice.name: Weighted Dice
weighted_dice.desc: Loaded: Increases your base damage maximum by 6. When calculating your base damage or creep bounty from last hits, the value is computed 2 times and the highest value is taken.

ash_legion_shield.name: Ash Legion Shield
ash_legion_shield.desc: Shield Wall: Reduce your own movement speed by 20 to provide a 160 physical damage barrier to allied player controlled units in a 800 unit radius. Lasts for 6 seconds.

riftshadow_prism.name: Riftshadow Prism
riftshadow_prism.desc: Refract: Spend 8% of your current life total to create a full health illusion that lasts for 20 seconds. The illusion has 50% outgoing damage and takes 200% of incoming damage.

metamorphic_mandible.name: Metamorphic Mandible
metamorphic_mandible.desc: Pupate: Enter into an insect form for 5 seconds, increasing magic resistance by 50% and movement speed by 15%. While an insect, your size is decreased and your armor is reduced by 45%.

idol_of_screeauk.name: Idol of Scree'auk
idol_of_screeauk.desc: False Flight: Gain 50% slow resistance, phased movement, and 25% evasion for 5 seconds.

flayers_bota.name: Flayer's Bota
flayers_bota.desc:
Bloodthirst: Gain 15% base damage and 30 attack speed for 6 seconds.
Bloodrush: Enemy heroes dying within 1200 units reset the cooldown of Bloodthirst.

spellslinger.name: Spellslinger
spellslinger.desc: Salvo: 20% of the mana used to cast abilities is recovered over 10 seconds.

prophets_pendulum.name: Prophet's Pendulum
prophets_pendulum.desc: Linger: 30% of incoming damage is delayed over 5 seconds.

stonefeather_satchel.name: Stonefeather Satchel
stonefeather_satchel.desc:
Transmogrify: Toggle to switch the contents of the Satchel between a pound of Feathers or Rocks.

Feathers: increase movement speed by 12 and distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.

Rocks: increase armor by 3 and decrease the distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.

enchanters_bauble.name: Enchanter's Bauble
enchanters_bauble.desc: Enchant: Increases the bonuses of the item's Neutral Enchantment by 15%. Every time this item is crafted again the bonus is increased by 40%.

harmonizer.name: Harmonizer
harmonizer.desc: Balance: Gain 5% spell manacost reduction for every spell off cooldown and 6% spell amplification for every spell on cooldown.

conjurers_catalyst.name: Conjurer's Catalyst
conjurers_catalyst.desc: Spellover: Dealing 100 spell damage to an enemy causes them to overheat and deal damage to their allies in a 300 unit radius. Hero targets deal 40 damage to their allies, other targets deal 15 damage.

foragers_kit.name: Forager's Kit
foragers_kit.desc: Forage: When the cooldown is ready, nearby trees that can be foraged will appear. By standing next to a tree for 1s, you can forage the tree and find flora, fungi or a bag of gold containing 30 gold.

partisans_brand.name: Partisan's Brand
partisans_brand.desc: Brand: Increases spell damage dealt to player controlled units by 9%.
